newsitem.title: GERMANY: EMI-one-offs don't guarantee fiscal discipline.
newsitem.headline: EMI-one-offs don't guarantee fiscal discipline.

text.p: The European Monetary Institute said on Wednesday that one-off efforts to reduce national deficits to make the grade for monetary union were not enough to guarantee sustained fiscal discipline.
"...It is emphasised that the improvement of the deficit by measures with a one-off effect does not ensure sustainable consolidation, ...," the EMI said in its convergence report.

The EMI also said that although most EU countries had failed to achieve sustainable budget control, "the latest projections for 1996 suggest that further progress has been made in the consolidation process."

The EMI, the forerunner to the future European Central Bank, is responsible for monitoring EU countries' efforts to fulfil the criteria needed to take part in the planned launch of Europe's single currency in 1999.
